verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack addresses whether Cerebras uses customer prompts or outputs for model training, or offers any opt-out, retention, or zero-data-retention control. Dedicated endpoints are described as private, reserved capacity not shared with other customers, but that concerns performance isolation, not training-data use, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
